All IDs are unique and all ARIA references resolve correctly. Here's what was built:

---

**`index.html`** + **`styles.css`** + **`app.js`**

### Sections
| Section | Details |
|---|---|
| **Announcement bar** | Promo message with dismissal |
| **Header** | Sticky, logo, search form, wishlist/account/cart icons, mobile hamburger |
| **Hero** | Full-width banner with headline, CTAs, decorative product cards, slide dots |
| **Category strip** | 8 icon-link tiles (Women, Men, Shoes, Accessories, Beauty, Home, Kids, Sale) |
| **Featured Products** | 8-card grid with filter tabs (All / Clothing / Shoes / Accessories / Beauty / Home) |
| **Trust bar** | Free returns · Fast shipping · Secure payments · 24/7 support |
| **Today's Deals** | 4-card deal grid with live countdown timer |
| **Style Stories** | 3-column editorial/blog cards |
| **Newsletter** | Email capture with success state |
| **Footer** | 4-column nav + social links + legal bar |

### Accessibility addressed
- Skip-to-content link, single `<main>`, one `<h1>`, landmark regions, `<nav aria-label>`
- All interactive elements have accessible names; wishlist toggle syncs `aria-pressed`
- Form fields have `<label>`, `aria-required`, `aria-invalid`, and error focus-first logic
- Cart "Add" announcements via `aria-live="polite"` toast region
- Forced-colors `@media` block; `prefers-reduced-motion` respected
- Focus outlines on every interactive element; no `tabindex` on static content
